UPSTREAM: mb/google/poppy/variants/nami: change type of board_sku_id() to uint32_t Tools/scripts, like mosys/arc-setup, use int (4 bytes) to read the sku id. In order to support "-1", we need to use uint32_t (4 bytes) instead of using uint16_t (2 bytes) data type. Otherwise, tools/scripts will read 65535 instead of -1. Another reason to change this is that sku_id can be supported by ec up to 4 bytes. BUG=b:73792190 TEST=mosys output "Platform not supported" for -1 sku id arc-setup read -1 sku id Change-Id: I629adfadd4d87872424fb27c2b9de489cf259337 Signed-off-by: Martin Roth <martinroth@chromium.org> Original-Commit-Id: f7b5955b363034c7235ea6a5fcc399eaf53120ce Original-Change-Id: Ib3baa8419f138abeb412ac09c2e7dc608e3b758b Original-Signed-off-by: Zhuohao Lee <zhuohao@chromium.org> Original-Reviewed-on: https://review.coreboot.org/25252 Original-Tested-by: build bot (Jenkins) <no-reply@coreboot.org> Original-Reviewed-by: Furquan Shaikh <furquan@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/973903
